Half-delay adds interpolation arithmetic and history memory; MACs and actual execution cost are not matched. It retains half of the current diagonal source; it is a partial timing intervention.
Training continues across Linux and Windows; environment influence is not excluded.
Model/optimizer/scheduler/main RNG restored; persistent DataLoader worker augmentation RNG restarts.
Fixed total steps and one seed remain unchanged; this is not independent replication.

Half-delay endpoint evaluation may split the same 1111 images across two GPUs after identity finishes; its wall time is not comparable to single-GPU inference latency. Report per-shard worker times and full two-card allocation including idle time.

costs.note: Finalized process attempts exclude active unfinished attempts. Remote two-card allocation/billing duration, deployment, validation and idle tail must be reported separately; never substitute only successful checkpoint trajectory time.

timing_intervention.authorization: User: one training is enough; exact MAC equality unnecessary; disclose differences honestly.
timing_intervention.intervention: At depths 2..5, diagonal donors use 0.5 current + 0.5 previous gated, continuously injected source. Center/cardinal donors use current source. Depth 1 uses current source for every tap.
preserved: eventual structural spatial support (to be verified)
not_matched: Windows full versus Linux intervention environment
subsequent augmentation RNG trajectories after existing full resume
timing_intervention.extra_reference_arithmetic_per_operator_: For each of K-1=4 mixed depths: 4*B*D*H*W real scalar multiplications and 2*B*D*H*W additions, shared across all four diagonal taps. Compiler may fold scalar operations; this is expression-level arithmetic, not measured kernel instructions.
timing_intervention.interpretation_limit: One independently trained partial timing intervention. Same-round diagonal contributions remain with weight 0.5. Does not remove all same-round paths, establish multi-seed robustness, or uniquely explain all improvement over SS2D.
timing_intervention.result_policy: Retain either sign and all 1111 images/11 videos; no favorable selection; never count images as training repetitions.
